source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of postfix evaluation (PDF 98-99).

blocks.text: Upar wale 3 4 2 * + jaise postfix expressions ko stack se hal kiya ja sakta hai. Qadam ba qadam tareeqa yeh hai. Misal: postfix expression 3 4 5 * + ko stack se hal karein.

items: Expression ko baen se daen parhein.
Number mile to use stack par push karein.
Operator mile to zaroorat ke mutabiq items (yahan do) stack se pop karein, operation karein, aur nateeja wapas stack par push karein.
* mila: 5 aur 4 pop kiye, zarb ki: 4 * 5 = 20
+ mila: 20 aur 3 pop kiye, jama kiya: 3 + 20 = 23
Aakhir mein stack par jo value bachti hai, wohi jawab hai: 23.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ke numbering mein chauthe qadam ko phir se 1 likha gaya hai; asal mein yeh chautha qadam hai: operator mile to do numbers pop karo, hisab karo, nateeja push karo.

blocks.alt: 3 4 5 * + ko baen se daen parhte hue stack: 3 push, 4 push, 5 push; * par 5 aur 4 nikal kar 20 push (stack 3, 20); + par 20 aur 3 nikal kar 23 push. Aakhir mein stack mein sirf 23.
blocks.caption: Postfix 3 4 5 * + ka hisab karte hue stack ki halatein (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

items: Postfix hal karna: number push; operator par do pop, hisab, nateeja push; 3 4 5 * + = 23.
